study type: Comparative study with propensity score matching
cohort: The study included 110 patients who underwent single-port access (SPA) laparoscopic adnexal surgeries.
finding: Spinal anesthesia was found to be a viable and safe alternative to general anesthesia for SPA laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy, effectively reducing immediate postoperative pain and nausea/vomiting scores.
